# student-citations-mcp

> APA, MLA and Chicago citations from a DOI, an ISBN or typed details. No account. Free and open source MCP server for AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others).

## Setup
- Run with npx -y student-citations-mcp
- No key or account. Optional CROSSREF_EMAIL.
- Styles are apa7, mla9 and chicago-ad. Italics are returned as asterisks.

## Tools
- format_citation
- cite_from_doi
- cite_from_isbn
- in_text_citation

## Links
- Source and README, https://github.com/AnonymousOnyx22/student-citations-mcp
- More free student MCP servers, https://brightspacemcp.com/more-mcps/
